_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. dry_run=true until you are ready for real money.

entry._comment_veto_positive_slip: Veto entries filling above the signal print (slip>0, strict); fail-open when slip unknown. Default true; set false to disable.

money._comment: Paper bankroll money management. Ticket size = risk_per_trade_pct * bankroll / hard_stop_pct, capped at the fixed risk.buy_*_per_trade sizes (size can only shrink, never grow). Daily USD kill-switch cap = min(fixed cap, daily_loss_pct * day-start bankroll). Entries blocked at max_drawdown_pct drawdown, resuming below drawdown_resume_pct.

allocator._comment: Deterministic entry allocator (allocator.py), scored at entry commit after all guardrails pass. Pure local arithmetic: no network, no AI, no randomness. It is an additional filter only; rug guard, caps, kill switches and cooldowns are unchanged. Remove this section to turn it off entirely.
allocator._comment_mode: shadow = trade exactly as before (1.0x, never skips) and journal allocator_score/take/multiplier/would_be_native; live = apply take/skip and size = min(configured ticket * multiplier, money.py risk ceiling), multiplier in [0.5, 2.0]; off = not called. Flip to live only on a 'pass' verdict in analysis/allocator_proposal.json, then restart the bot.
allocator._comment_take_threshold: take = score >= take_threshold (score in 0..1; 0.5 = neutral signal = 1.0x).
allocator._comment_weights: Logistic weights on features normalized to [-1, 1] around a typical signal; missing features contribute 0. Defaults mirror allocator.DEFAULT_WEIGHTS (mild priors). Update only by copying weights from a passing analysis/allocator_proposal.json.
